insights.summary: Regulated customers want configurable redaction of identifiers in transcripts and summaries, with role-based access and audit.
insights.quote: We need to pick which identifiers get masked, and we need it driven by role. A loan officer shouldn't see a full Social Security number on a transcript, but someone in compliance reviewing a complaint should be able to unmask it, and that unmask action needs to land in an audit log showing who viewed what and when.

insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: We added a 'Property Type' picklist value for condos, and calls just stopped landing on the object. No error on our side, nothing in the call record, just silence.
